question: Is the protected full-width KV transport needed for the shipped Qwen ROM composition?
decision: NO for performance and exactness: the shipped path is the measured, exact STREAM4 landing (owner 2026-10-06); the protected full-width transport is explored, not adopted, and enters no composition (0 cycles, 0 credit). The missing transport PROTECTION stays a reliability GAP in no_ecc_inventory (AGENTS ROM policy keeps HBM/link protection required); it is not a performance gate.
owner_decision: EXPLORED, NOT ADOPTED (owner 2026-10-06): not part of the shipped configuration

shipped_stream4.note: full token at P8191, 36 layers + head, 4 ranks, all KV landed through STREAM4; this is the token every Qwen composition starts from

protected_fullwidth_L0.note: cold full-shape L0 exact on 4 dies after the SAME_CYCLE_GO fix; 6188 cycles vs the shipped STREAM4 cold L0 6044 (+144); no prefetch, no full token

protected_fullwidth_full36_r1.failure: MEMORY FAULT stage=L0 cyc=14 dies=f kv_code=8000 (retained, not re-run)

consequence.no_ecc_inventory: qwen_rom STREAM4 KV transport stays GAP (protection none); closing it is a reliability item (e.g. per-sector check bits through the HBM ECC pins at the landing CDC), priced separately if the owner reopens it
consequence.reopen_condition: if the owner requires transport protection for publication, the protected path must first run a full token (it has only L0) and its exposed fill cost must be composed
